items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: He plays with Pete Fountain and plays vibraphone.

ctx.x: Uh, no. He played drums. I knew about it. I played drums? Where are you from? Where are you from?

He's from here. He plays with Pete Fountain and plays vibraphone. No, I can't play with him. Yeah, but he might be a little after your time. Yeah. Well, anyway, we never did get this, uh, you said this man, Angelo, uh... Palmasana? Palmasana is on banjo when you're at the ringside. Yeah, he played nothing but banjo.

He didn't play no guitar or nothing in heaven like that. He used it rather. In other words, that boy would sit down and play a single note or anything. Play a melody, play anything you want. Just like a piano player.
